limitations: No market refitting, new return path or candidate selection in this audit. Saved target actions, fee funding and utility are independently reconstructed on saved paths.
Every checkpoint recorded objective and strict incumbent ordering are checked; non-selected checkpoint full paths are not stored, so their objective scalars are not independently rerun.
Gradient-cache correctness is supported by frozen source control flow, parameter_epoch linkage and recorded per-update exact forward parity. No global optimum or full-horizon gradient claim.
Three constant-input seeds are structurally identical effective policies, not independent market evidence.
